typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	FileName as string (),
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string (),
	userName as string ()
}

source(output(
		Date as date,
		Account as decimal(18,0),
		{Customer Name} as string,
		{Product Offering} as string,
		{Cage Asset} as string,
		IBX as string,
		Cage as string,
		{Cage Serial} as string,
		{Metering Type} as string,
		{Usable kVA} as double,
		{Average Draw} as double,
		{Daily Peak Draw} as double,
		{Average 30 day Peak Draw kVA-to-Draw} as double,
		{Redundant Draw} as double,
		{Draw Cap} as double,
		{Primary Draw } as double,
		{Average 30 day Peak Draw} as double
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(FName = $FileName,
		UploadDate = currentTimestamp(),
		EtlUser = $userName) ~> DerivedColumn
FlatFileSource aggregate(groupBy(),
	rowcount = count(1)) ~> RowCount0
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		DailyPeakDraw as double,
		Account as string,
		AverageDraw as double,
		Avg30dayPeakDraw as double,
		UploadDate as string,
		Cage as string,
		UsablekVA as double,
		Avg30dayPeakDrawkVAtoDraw as double,
		PrimaryDraw as double,
		CageSerial as string,
		FName as string,
		Date as string,
		DrawCap as double,
		EtlUser as string,
		CageAsset as string,
		ProductOffering as string,
		RedundantDraw as double,
		CustomerName as string,
		IBX as string,
		MeteringType as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		DailyPeakDraw = {Daily Peak Draw},
		Account,
		AverageDraw = {Average Draw},
		Avg30dayPeakDraw = {Average 30 day Peak Draw},
		UploadDate,
		Cage,
		UsablekVA = {Usable kVA},
		Avg30dayPeakDrawkVAtoDraw = {Average 30 day Peak Draw kVA-to-Draw},
		PrimaryDraw = {Primary Draw },
		CageSerial = {Cage Serial},
		FName,
		Date,
		DrawCap = {Draw Cap},
		EtlUser,
		CageAsset = {Cage Asset},
		ProductOffering = {Product Offering},
		RedundantDraw = {Redundant Draw},
		CustomerName = {Customer Name},
		IBX,
		MeteringType = {Metering Type}),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
RowCount0 sink(validateSchema: false,
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	store: 'cache',
	format: 'inline',
	output: true,
	saveOrder: 1) ~> RowCountCACHESINK
